- Updated the bug task status to planned and added the plan path. The plan ends with NOW EXECUTE, so the next agent should execute it and run make check, make test, and make lint.

- Next: run focused schema-source test, then full make check, make test, and make lint; update task checkboxes if all pass.

- Failure is expected fallout from changing Toezegging.kamerbriefNakoming from single scalar column to repeated scalar side table: checked-in generated migration is stale.
- Next: regenerate/update checked-in PostgreSQL migration from opentk-db::postgres_schema, rerun focused postgres_schema test, then rerun make test and make lint.

- Regenerated checked-in PostgreSQL migration after schema change: Toezegging.kamerbriefNakoming moved from toezegging.kamerbrief_nakoming column to repeated scalar table toezegging__kamerbrief_nakoming with foreign-key index.
- Used a temporary render-schema-migration binary to call opentk-db::postgres_schema render functions, then removed the temporary binary.
- Focused test cargo test -p opentk-db --test postgres_schema checked_in_migrations_match_schema_spec passed.

- Next: run make lint, then update bug task checkboxes/passes, run task_switch, commit all files, and push.

- Updated the execution plan checklist as complete, including the final improve-code-boundaries review.
- Reran make check after final file changes; it passed cleanly.
- Next: task_switch, git add all files, commit with required task finished message, push, then quit.
